text: Concern about 12 beats: every new page needs bound cells of at least MIN_BOUND_POOL=4 variants, i.e. ~50% more corpus for the same word count. Cheaper alternative content can offer: keep 8 beats and mark a turnAfter split inside existing multi-sentence variants (paired pages already have a natural split). No new text, no pool growth; cost moves to reader and illustration count. Bedtime should not split its last two pages.
